answer: Bind each identity to a sequential memory-hard chain: every link is an Argon2 pass over the previous output, so producing it needs both memory and time in order. At its zenith the chain is long and unforgeable, and a harbor cannot shelter a chain that was never built. An ocean of parallel GPUs cannot speed one chain, because each link waits for the last, while the network verifies any link cheaply by recomputing a single step.
